name: Lost
source:
On the last day of school, Kanna decided to approach a girl who has been seen digging around the school field these days. 

[From [url=https://hitamitu.itch.io/lost]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在学期的最后一天，神奈决定上前去向一名女生搭话——这阵子总有人看见她在学校操场四周埋头挖掘着什么。

[摘自[url=https://hitamitu.itch.io/lost]itch.io[/url]]
